projects.title: Decision-table shape and digest
projects.hypothesis: A bounded decision table can be normalized without changing row order or declared values.
projects.null_or_failure_condition: Duplicate object labels, unknown attributes, Boolean-as-integer values, or a changed digest are rejected.
projects.acceptance_or_falsifier_gate: Independent shape and digest checks agree for all fifteen fixtures.
projects.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the failed subject at zero credit, correct only the smallest named dependency, and rerun only the unsatisfied check.

projects.title: Indiscernibility partition
projects.hypothesis: Equality on a declared attribute subset induces a deterministic partition of the finite universe.
projects.null_or_failure_condition: A block overlaps another block, omits an object, or changes under row permutation.
projects.acceptance_or_falsifier_gate: Direct grouping and pairwise-equivalence closure return identical sorted blocks.
